routesDefinition: Routes run are an estimate. nflverse participation data records the route only for the targeted receiver, so a player's routes are counted as the dropbacks (pass attempts, sacks and scrambles) on which he was on the field as a WR, TE or RB. Players who stay in to block are still counted, so routes run high (and yards per route run low) for TEs and especially RBs.

definitions.snap_pct: Offensive snaps divided by the team's offensive snaps.
definitions.tgt_share: Targets divided by team pass attempts (sacks excluded, throwaways included).
definitions.ay_share: Air yards on his targets divided by the team's air yards on all pass attempts.
definitions.wopr: Weighted opportunity rating: 1.5 x target share + 0.7 x air-yards share.
definitions.adot: Average depth of target: air yards per target.
definitions.catch_rate: Receptions divided by targets FTN charted as catchable.
definitions.rush_share: Carries divided by team run plays (QB runs included).
definitions.rz_tgt_share: Targets inside the opponent's 20 divided by team pass attempts from there.
definitions.i10_tgt_share: Targets inside the opponent's 10 divided by team pass attempts from there.
definitions.rz_car_share: Carries inside the opponent's 20 divided by team runs from there.
definitions.i10_car_share: Carries inside the opponent's 10 divided by team runs from there.
definitions.ez_tgt: Targets whose catch spot is at or past the goal line.
definitions.td_gap: Touchdowns scored minus expected touchdowns from a yardline model (positive = scoring above expectation).
definitions.tgt_per_snap: Targets per offensive snap. A proxy for targets per route run, which is not published for this season.
definitions.ypc_stk: Yards per carry into a stacked box (8 or more defenders).
definitions.ypc_lgt: Yards per carry into a light box (6 or fewer defenders).
definitions.ypt_bl: Yards per target when the defense blitzed (at least one blitzer).
definitions.pa_share: Share of his charted targets that came on play action.
definitions.scr_share: Share of his charted targets that were screens.
definitions.drop_rate: Drops divided by targets FTN charted as catchable.
definitions.yprr: Yards per route run, using the route estimate in routesDefinition.
definitions.tprr: Targets per route run, using the route estimate in routesDefinition.
